ITEM 1 | Dark brown, glossy braised meat pieces with reddish-brown sauce and small chopped tomato chunks and bits of green herb on top, clustered in the upper left of the plate, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm, piled about 3 cm high, moist and holding shape | 180
ITEM 2 | Single drumstick-shaped piece with pale tan-beige skin partly browned and a smooth bone end sticking out, about 12 cm long and 4 cm thick at the meaty end, glossy and moist, sitting center-right of the plate | 130
ITEM 3 | Three golden-brown roasted potato wedges with crisp, slightly browned edges and fluffy pale interior, each about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm thick, scattered at the left edge of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Whole and halved button mushrooms, light brown caps with darker browned edges, glossy and slightly wet, about 1.5 to 3 cm across, clustered in the upper center-right of the plate | 60
ITEM 5 | Curly dark green kale or leafy greens, lightly wilted, bright green with darker folds, moist and slightly glossy, mounded on the right side of the plate about 10 cm by 7 cm and 2 cm high | 70
ITEM 6 | Broad dark green spinach-like leaves, wilted and glossy with a light oily sheen, spread across the lower right of the plate, with a stem trailing off the edge | 45
ITEM 7 | Diced red tomato pieces and small sliced red bell pepper pieces, bright red with glossy skins, scattered among the greens in the lower center of the plate | 25
ITEM 8 | Pale cream-colored soft mound with slight sheen, small piece near the top right of the greens, about 3 cm across and 1 cm high, possibly melted or soft | 15
